name: ELIX Media
description: High-fidelity cinema video, audio waveform visualizer, and pan-and-zoom media inspector for ELIX OS
author: ELIX Systems

permissions.reason: Open and inspect local video, audio, and image assets
Notify user upon playback completion or media errors

capabilities.name: open_media
capabilities.description: Open and load audio, video, or high-res image files into the active canvas.

mediaPath.description: Path to the target media asset

capabilities.name: control_playback
capabilities.description: Control playback state (play, pause, toggle, stop, seek, volume, speed).

capabilities.name: inspect_media_info
capabilities.description: Inspect codec, resolution, bitrate, color space, audio channels, and EXIF metadata.

capabilities.name: generate_thumbnail_strip
capabilities.description: Generate keyframe thumbnail preview strip across video timeline intervals.

capabilities.name: set_image_transform
capabilities.description: Apply pan-and-zoom transformation matrix, rotation, and mirror flip on image canvas.
